# Allow search engines to crawl the whole public site, except the admin area
# and per-user pages (nothing there is useful in search results).
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /profile

# The sitemap is generated by the API from the live database. If the domain
# changes, update this URL (and SITE_URL in src/lib/site.ts + the server env).
Sitemap: https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/api/sitemap.xml
